evidence.role: Makes sale end inclusive and the request deadline exclusive.
Computes the request and callback deadlines from their respective timestamps.
Provides the sole authenticated external callback path.
Ignores callbacks at or after the exclusive callback deadline before any resolution write.

searched.where: Five production files and all 31 dependency-hashes.json paths
searched.result: All included in the review; SHA-256 verification produced 31 matches and zero mismatches.
2 hits: IRaffle.sol declaration and Raffle.sol implementation; no in-scope caller or alternate wrapper.
11 hits; enforcement resolves to Raffle.sol:L240-L247, L458-L460 and RaffleConstants.sol:L32-L33.
15 hits; the relevant writer, calculation, and filter are Raffle.sol:L253, L463-L465, L509-L515.
6 textual hits; one Chainlink external gateway and one Raffle override, with no second callback entrypoint.
6 hits; the sole implementation uses the same request and callback deadlines and permits refunds beginning at equality.
0 hits; the durations are expressed with Solidity's `2 days` unit.

reasoning: The sole request path rejects timestamps below endTime and timestamps greater than or equal to endTime plus two days, so exactly endTime is time-eligible and exactly the deadline is excluded. The authenticated callback path ignores timestamps greater than or equal to drawRequestedAt plus two days before any resolution write. Callers, modifiers, constructors, clone initialization, refund transitions, state writers, type widths, and the inherited callback gateway provide no bypass.
